outcome: recommendation for immediate action (fetal blood sample or immediate delivery)
cohort: 35 neonates with NE and evidence of birth hypoxia (cases) and 105 neonates without NE or birth hypoxia (controls) born in 2010-2011 in New Zealand
finding: Experienced clinicians, using CTG tracings, detected 3 out of 4 infants subsequently diagnosed with NE and recommended expediting delivery for over 40% of infants with NE.
